coder_notes: Mixed population: GBM IDH-wildtype, IDH-mutant astrocytoma grade 2-4 and diffuse midline glioma are all eligible. IDH and H3 rows reflect the molecularly defined eligible diagnoses; no single status is required for the whole trial, so adjudicators may drop them. RRM2 is the triapine target (ribonucleotide reductase subunit) but is only a descriptive tumour-tissue correlative, so target engagement is coded no. PK includes peri-tumoral dialysate (tumour tissue) and CNS sampling. Methemoglobinemia-inducing drugs and G6PD are safety items and not coded.
